title: [main] bug 640925 - Add report extension for Standard Sales Pro Forma and Draft Invoice
summary: Czech report extensions add missing fields to draft and pro forma invoices for approval workflows, matching the layout of posted Czech invoices with registration numbers, VAT dates, bank details, and payment information.
key_points: Two new report extensions (11707, 11708) extend reports 1303 and 1302 with Czech RDLC layouts
Added header fields include customer registration numbers, VAT date, bank account details, payment symbols, and employee info
Pro forma extension includes VAT recapitulation section with calculated VAT amount lines
No QR codes or tax implications since documents are unposted
Layouts clearly marked as draft/pro forma to distinguish from final tax documents
